description: An additive oscillator: eight sliders set the levels of eight partials in a square, triangle or sawtooth series

params.text: Sets the frequency, four octaves either side of C4 at 261.63Hz
Sets the level of the fundamental
Sets the level of the second partial in the series, which is the third harmonic in the square and triangle shapes and the second harmonic in the sawtooth
Sets the level of the third partial in the series, which is the fifth harmonic in the square and triangle shapes and the third harmonic in the sawtooth
Sets the level of the fourth partial in the series, which is the seventh harmonic in the square and triangle shapes and the fourth harmonic in the sawtooth
Sets the level of the fifth partial in the series, which is the ninth harmonic in the square and triangle shapes and the fifth harmonic in the sawtooth
Sets the level of the sixth partial in the series, which is the eleventh harmonic in the square and triangle shapes and the sixth harmonic in the sawtooth
Sets the level of the seventh partial in the series, which is the thirteenth harmonic in the square and triangle shapes and the seventh harmonic in the sawtooth
Sets the level of the eighth partial in the series, which is the fifteenth harmonic in the square and triangle shapes and the eighth harmonic in the sawtooth
Steps the waveform on each press, square to triangle to sawtooth and back to square

inputs.text: Adds to the frequency knob at 1V per octave, with the total held between four octaves below C4 and six above

outputs.text: The summed partials, roughly 10V peak to peak

notes: a slider sets its partial's level on top of the slope the shape already has: divided by the harmonic number for the square, by its square for the triangle, and by the number for the sawtooth.
the sawtooth series alternates the sign of its partials, so neighbouring sliders work against each other there.
of the three small lamps, the first is lit for the square, the second for the triangle and the third for the sawtooth; the choice is saved with the patch.
a partial that would land above half the sample rate is dropped and one within 2000Hz of it is faded out, so the top sliders go quiet on high notes.
Rack's randomise picks one of the three shapes at random.
